policy.choreography: Signed CHR +0x1e and native target offsets drive every full forest approach/return; frame interpolation and independent path clocks remain previews.
policy.backdrop: runtime development gradient; original battle background unknown
policy.intrinsic_blend: same-source-frame source-over main followed by lighter intrinsic; RGB565 destination saturation approximated
policy.death: Native id12/id2 lookup and fade draws are settled by battle_reactions; Canvas fade and death pose timing remain previews.
policy.enemy_contacts: All source contact events for both learned skills of each forest enemy; native combination record composition is performed at runtime.

limits: Original sprites and all source contact events for the currently exposed two player skills and six learned forest enemy skills.
Coordinate projection, interpolation and additive Canvas remain presentation policies; original renderer and OS animation clocks are not executed.
